core: Visceral smooth muscle and organ function
qualifier: gut, urinary and reproductive tracts
name: Visceral smooth muscle function of gut, urinary and reproductive tracts
rationale: Members cover contraction and motility of gastrointestinal, urinary, uterine and male reproductive organs (with gastric secretion and development), and the reproductive acts plus gut motility distinguish it from smooth muscle relaxation, tachykinin/serotonin and enteric nervous system neighbours.

qualifier: sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona binding
name: Fertilization: sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona binding
rationale: All members describe the sperm-egg encounter from capacitation and motility through acrosome exocytosis, zona penetration, membrane fusion and egg activation, unlike neighbours centred on spermatogenesis, sperm tail assembly or germline epigenetics.

qualifier: cornification and lipoxygenase hepoxilin synthesis
name: Epidermal barrier: cornification and lipoxygenase hepoxilin synthesis
rationale: Members combine cornified envelope assembly and skin barrier establishment with the 12R-LOX/eLOX3 hepoxilin and linoleate lipid pathway defective in ichthyoses, whereas neighbours cover keratinocyte differentiation alone or general eicosanoid/fatty acid metabolism.

qualifier: gonadotropin and activin signalling
name: Gonad development and gonadotropin–activin endocrine regulation
rationale: Members span ovarian follicle and testis development, sex determination and oocyte maturation together with gonadotropin, activin/AMH, progesterone and prolactin signalling, unlike neighbours about fertilization, genital tract morphogenesis or meiosis and germline epigenetics.

qualifier: Rap1 and MAPK linkage in platelet activation
name: Integrin–Rap1 signalling to MAPK and cytoskeleton in platelets
rationale: Members describe integrin adhesion signalling via Rap1, p130Cas and GRB2:SOS to MAPK and actin remodelling plus platelet activation modules, distinct from GPCR-driven platelet activation, coagulation and Rho/ILK focal adhesion neighbours.

qualifier: methyltransferase complexes and imprinting
name: DNA methylation and histone lysine methyltransferase complexes
rationale: All members concern DNA CpG methylation, imprinting, PRC2 and MLL/WDR5 lysine methyltransferase complexes, unlike neighbours focused on arginine methylation, histone demethylases or CHD/NuRD remodelling.

qualifier: PPAR–PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptor transcription
name: White adipogenesis with PPAR–PGC-1α and circadian clock transcription
rationale: Members combine white fat cell differentiation and adipose development with PPARA/PPARG, PGC-1alpha mitochondrial biogenesis and BMAL/ROR/REV-ERB clock transcription, unlike brown/beige thermogenic or LXR/SREBP lipogenic neighbours.

qualifier: aldosterone and potassium responses
name: Sodium transport regulation with aldosterone and potassium responses
rationale: Members regulate sodium import, export and transporter activity together with responses to aldosterone and potassium, distinguishing them from osmotic stress and chloride cotransporter neighbours.

qualifier: iron-sulfur cluster assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
name: TCA cycle with iron–sulfur cluster assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
rationale: Members cover TCA intermediates (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate), TCA enzyme maturation with Fe-S cluster assembly, succinate dehydrogenase electron transport and ATP synthesis, unlike neighbours on 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase lipoylation, PDH/CoA or the malate-aspartate shuttle.

qualifier: depolarization-driven calcium entry and short-term potentiation
name: Presynaptic depolarization-driven calcium entry and short-term potentiation
rationale: Members concern presynaptic depolarization, calcium channel opening and cytosolic calcium that enhance vesicle exocytosis and short-term potentiation, unlike neighbours on G-protein inhibition of calcium channels, inhibitory synapse assembly or active-zone vesicle priming.

qualifier: Nodal left-right signalling and extracellular ligand sequestration
name: Somitogenesis and Nodal left–right patterning via ligand sequestration
rationale: Members combine somite segmentation and tail/axis elongation with Nodal-dependent left-right asymmetry and extracellular BMP/ligand sequestration, which neighbours on limb, neural plate, Hox or Notch glycosylation lack.

qualifier: photoreceptor outer segment development
name: Primary cilium trafficking and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members cover intraflagellar transport, BBSome and ciliary cargo targeting, transition zone and basal body anchoring alongside photoreceptor outer segment and retinal neuron development, unlike motile cilia, sperm flagellum or mitotic centrosome neighbours.

qualifier: growth-plate chondrocyte maturation and RUNX2
name: Growth-plate chondrocyte maturation and RUNX2-driven ossification
rationale: Members span chondrocyte condensation, proliferation, hypertrophy and RUNX2-regulated chondrocyte/osteoblast maturation in endochondral and intramembranous ossification, unlike neighbours on joints and tendon, BMP/Wnt osteoblast control or articular cartilage.

qualifier: p21-mediated G1 arrest and p14ARF/p16INK4A loss in cancer
name: TP53–p21 G1 arrest and p14ARF/p16INK4A loss in cancer
rationale: Members describe TP53 regulation and p21-driven G1 arrest plus cancer defects in p14ARF, p16INK4A and TP53 that evade senescence, unlike neighbours on senescence induction/SASP, RB1-E2F or p53-driven apoptosis.

qualifier: histones and tubulin
name: Protein lysine acetylation of histones and tubulin
rationale: Members concern lysine acetylation of histones and other proteins including tubulin acetylation state and its link to centriole control, unlike neighbours on protein methylation, centromeric chromatin assembly, BAF remodelling or tubulin glutamylation.

qualifier: COPII cargo loading at ER exit sites
name: COPII-mediated cargo export from ER to Golgi
rationale: All members describe COPII coat formation, cargo concentration at ER exit sites and anterograde ER-to-Golgi vesicle transport, unlike neighbours on ERAD, vesicle tethering, COPI retrograde traffic or SRP-dependent ER targeting.

qualifier: inherited enzyme deficiencies
name: Inherited urea cycle enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Every member is a disease variant of a urea cycle enzyme (NAGS, CPS1, OTC, ASS1, ASL, ARG1), whereas neighbours describe normal urea cycle, arginine and ornithine metabolism.

qualifier: ribbon dynamics, vesicle budding and membrane tubulation
name: Golgi ribbon organization, vesicle budding and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly and positioning together with COPI/Golgi vesicle budding and membrane tubulation, unlike neighbours on COPI retrograde and intra-Golgi traffic or Rab/ARF GTPase regulation.

qualifier: cerebellar Purkinje layer formation
name: Cerebellar Purkinje layer formation and locomotor coordination
rationale: Members link Purkinje cell layer formation to walking, righting reflex and adult locomotion, distinguishing them from neighbours on exploratory/psychomotor behaviour, granule cell and hindbrain development.

qualifier: lens transparency, cornea and exocrine ducts
name: Lens transparency, cornea and exocrine gland/duct development
rationale: Members centre on lens fiber morphogenesis and gap-junction-dependent transparency, cornea development and lacrimal gland and bile duct formation, unlike neighbours on inner ear, retina, photoreceptors or ocular vasculature.

core: Direct enzymatic editing of nucleic acid bases
qualifier: deamination, oxidative demethylation and alkylation reversal
name: Nucleobase deamination, oxidative demethylation and alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members share enzymes that chemically rewrite bases in place: ADAR/APOBEC RNA/DNA deamination with antiviral restriction, TET-TDG oxidative demethylation and ALKBH/MGMT alkylation reversal, unlike base excision repair, broad DNA repair or HIV lifecycle neighbours.

qualifier: CD22 tuning and B cell proliferation
name: B cell receptor signalling tuning and B cell proliferation
rationale: Members cover antigen-triggered BCR second messengers, its positive and CD22-mediated negative regulation, B cell proliferation and B-1 cells with B cell modules, unlike neighbours on B cell development, RAS/BTK activation or germinal centre and plasma cell biology.

qualifier: terminal fucosylation, sialylation and selectin ligands
name: Glycan biosynthesis with terminal fucosylation, sialylation and selectin ligands
rationale: Members span N- and O-GalNAc glycan and glycosphingolipid synthesis with GDP-fucose, sialylation, sulfation and ABO/Lewis antigens that build selectin ligands for leukocyte rolling and stem cell homing, unlike neighbours on nucleotide-sugar synthesis, glycosaminoglycans or O-mannose/O-fucose glycosylation.

qualifier: inherited gamma-glutamyl cycle defects
name: Gamma-glutamyl cycle glutathione synthesis and its inherited defects
rationale: Members are glutathione synthesis and recycling and its enzyme deficiencies (GCLC, GSS, GGT1, OPLAH, ACY1), unlike neighbours on glutathione transport/catabolism or cysteine and sulfur metabolism.

qualifier: CCR2/CX3CR1 guidance and its restraint
name: CCR2/CX3CR1-guided monocyte migration and its restraint
rationale: Members are CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte trafficking modules with negative regulation of monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis and monocyte aggregation, unlike neighbours on monocyte activation, positive chemotaxis/extravasation or general chemokine clusters.
